# Master Plan — Fix All 64 Gaps

**Created:** 2026-04-14
**Generated by:** ROADMAP + gap-to-pr-converter + priority-pr-planning skills
**Scope:** 64 gaps (GAP-001..064) organized into **13 waves** across **8 sprints + post-GA**

---

## Executive Summary

**Total effort:** ~300 person-days
**Timeline:**
- **Solo dev:** 6-9 months to GA
- **Team 3 devs:** 2-3 months to GA
- **Team 5+ devs:** 1-2 months to GA

**Target GA:** After Wave 10 (17 P0 + 14 P1 = 31 gaps closed)
**Post-GA:** 33 remaining gaps over 6-12 months

---

## Skills Used

Plan này generated via skill chain:

1. **ROADMAP.md** → epic grouping + sprint structure
2. **persona-based-business-review** → K-12 gaps prioritized
3. **simulation-gap-finder** → cross-persona coverage

## Critical Path

Slowest sequence to GA:

```
W1 (2w) → W2 (3w) → W3 (3w) → W5 (2w) → W6 (3w) → W10 (2w) = 15 weeks minimum
```

With 3-dev parallelism (W3/W4/W5 simultaneous):
```
W1 (2w) → W2 (3w) → [W3||W4||W5] (3w) → W6 (3w) → [W7||W8||W9] (2w) → W10 (2w) = 15w → 10w
```

---

## Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|--------|-----------|
| External designer late (GAP-011) | W1 delay → cascade | Start hiring NOW, parallel tracks |
| Legal counsel unavailable (GAP-042) | W4 delay | Early engagement; template contracts |
| Gemma 4 issues (GAP-006) | W6 delay | Fallback to llama3.1 maintained |
| Wave 2 data model breaking existing tenants | Production impact | Feature flag (GAP-044) |
| 3 devs not available | Timeline stretches 2-3x | Solo-dev option acceptable |

## Per-Wave Execution Checklist

Mỗi wave KHỞI ĐỘNG:
- [ ] Run `/gap-to-pr GAP-XXX,GAP-YYY --wave waveName`
- [ ] Generate wave plan doc: `documents/03-planning/wave-NN.md`
- [ ] Create wave branch: `wave/NN-name`
- [ ] Kickoff meeting: align team
- [ ] Update gap statuses to 🟡 PLANNED

Mỗi wave TRONG:
- [ ] Daily standup
- [ ] Follow `priority-pr-planning` guidelines
- [ ] Each PR: `two-stage-code-review` + `design-pattern-advisor` check
- [ ] Tests + business doc updates per PR (Living Docs)

Mỗi wave HOÀN THÀNH:
- [ ] Run `/wave-completion-check --gaps GAP-X,GAP-Y`
- [ ] Gap statuses → 🟢 DONE
- [ ] Update ROADMAP sprint progress
- [ ] Retrospective: learnings documented
- [ ] Unblock dependent waves

## Team Scenarios

### Scenario A: Solo Dev
- W1 → W2 → W3 → W4 → W5 → W6 → W7 → W8 → W9 → W10 sequential
- Timeline: ~6 months to GA
- Can launch với 17 P0 gaps closed (skip some P1)

### Scenario B: 3 Devs Parallel
- W1 sequential
- W2 sequential (data model foundation)
- **W3 || W4 || W5** parallel (3 streams)
- **W7 || W8 || W9** parallel
- Timeline: ~10-12 weeks to GA

### Scenario C: 5+ Devs
- Above + dedicated security team (W4)
- Dedicated designer (W1 templates)
- Timeline: ~6-8 weeks to GA
